about: The collecta of the formulary “Epiphany of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, who today didst make known Thine Only-begotten to the Gentiles, a star leading the way, graciously grant that we, who have already come to know Thee by faith, be led onward until we contemplate the beauty of Thy sublime majesty. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
